added_failures_note: The reviewed run recorded no baseline_suite or after_suite (both blank in its manifest), so it carries no two-arm suite delta of its own. Its gate was the per-arm runner at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py, whose log runner-jev.log ends EXIT=0, plus the record's containment verdict and the runner's containment self-check that fires on planted inputs; the change touches only docs/evidence paths that no test module covers, so the added-failure set is empty rather than unmeasured by a suite that could have exercised it.

findings.text: follow-on: cost_limit_passed_usd holds 1.98, which is the ceiling handed to the apply, not a pass/fail verdict, so a reader comparing spend (0.74159) against a field named for a verdict compares a spend to a cap; the value is set at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:508 as min(apply_cap(planned_calls), ARM_BUDGET_USD), while the landing fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-divertor-recomb-jev.html:35 names both the 1.98 effective cap and the 2.00 arm budget correctly.

follow-on: the containment evidence carries two attribution lanes and the run-id lane measured zero on both graphs -- scratch_scope_run_rows 0 at line 24 despite 26 scratch ledger rows naming this apply's members -- so for this arm the live-graph attribution rests on the member-name window lane alone and the run-id lane cannot fire on the live side; the planted case in containment-self-check.log proves the check would fire if a row did carry a run id, but no such row was observed in either graph.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion at all -- it is a data record and a doc -- so nothing committed reddens if the record's scores or containment verdict were later replaced; the only guard is the runner's post-apply containment gate at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:617, exercised separately in containment-self-check.log where three planted cases fail as expected and one passes.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the runner invocation in runner-jev.log whose last line is EXIT=0, and the recorded numbers reconcile against independent sources -- calls 26 at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/neutral_power_of_divertor_due_to_recombination-jev.json:10 sums from the six per-model counts at lines 185/190/196/201/206/210 and spend_usd 0.74159 from their per-model spend, while the anchors, members, source_export and adoption_rule match ssog-anchor-ab/selection.json -- but no pytest arm ran, so the added-failure delta is an empty set rather than a suite result.
justifications.fit: the record follows the ab-record JSON idiom of its siblings in ssog-anchor-ab/ and the landing HTML follows the evidence-fragment idiom at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-aperture-jev.html:1, though docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/neutral_power_of_divertor_due_to_recombination-jev.json:31 carries a field name that asserts a verdict its value does not hold.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/neutral_power_of_divertor_due_to_recombination-jev.json:182 records outcome_status complete at anchor plasma_power_of_divertor_due_to_recombination for arm jev, the deliverable the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition of its own and forks no capability -- the record is produced by the existing runner docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:399 run_arm, which delegates to harmonize.plan_family_applies and graph.temp_neo4j.
